correctness.rationale: The given RESULT defines the ordinary matching complex of the 17-edge P3 x P4 grid, six row/column-reflection edge orbits, deletion D_e and endpoint deletion L_e. Independent enumeration reconstructed all 13 face sets (intact 823 faces, edge-deletion 625/683/605/673/691/700, links 198/140/218/150/132/123). Original verify_grid34_defect.py BASE pivot order, contrary to its asserted reference output, leaves TEN critical dimension-3 faces and ONE critical dimension-2 face (406 pairs), so the original verifier throws instead of certifying 9 S^3. The defect was reproduced from the original published pivot sequence. A complete corrected standalone verifier with a different 17-pivot BASE order was written and actually run; it verifies 407 base pairs and exactly nine dimension-3 critical faces, all 13 augmented Morse matchings acyclic by sorting every Hasse cover, all deletion/link critical counts, Euler recurrences and six orbits. Each ordinary Morse model has one 0-cell and only top cells, yielding integral wedges. Since D_e is 2-connected and L_e a wedge of 2-spheres, all inclusions L_e -> D_e are nullhomotopic, making the full matching complex homotopy pushout D_e vee Sigma L_e. The fixed-graph claim survives only with the supplied corrected proof certificate; no arbitrary-width inference follows.
